content: portion (formerly python-intervals, renamed after python-intervals stopped being updated) is the actively maintained Python interval library, current version 2.6.0, supports closed/open/half-open finite and semi-infinite intervals, interval sets with union/intersection/complement/difference. Suitable for continuous-interval math later. For v1 fixed-duration grid, a hand-rolled half-open (start,end] or [start,end) interval type (frozen dataclass/NamedTuple) is simpler, zero-dependency, and easier to control serialization for the public contract; portion's rich interval-set algebra would be pulled in when the continuous/arbitrary-duration extension lands.
